transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been trying to clean up my image and get into a better routine for some arts board stuff, but it’s made me more tense and down than I expected. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep letting little things slide—like planning notes for the fair or design drafts—and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of trying to catch up.
How long have you been feeling this way—tense, down, and guilty about falling behind?
About two months now—since I started trying to overhaul my routine and how I present myself.
Over these past two months, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even outside of the stress around this routine change?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear loss of interest in everything—I think it’s more that I get caught up in the stress about the routine.
Besides the stress about your routine and image, do you find yourself worrying excessively about several other areas of your life—like health, finances, or relationships—on most days?
No, I wouldn’t say it’s spread to a bunch of other things. It mostly feels tied to the routine and how I’m coming across.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over these past two months—such as trouble falling asleep, waking up frequently, or sleeping much more or less than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in my sleep, at least not one that stands out to me.
Have you noticed feeling unusually low on energy or fatigued most days over these past two months, even when you haven't been especially active?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed being unusually tired most days. It doesn’t really stand out as a problem to me.
When you think about how you've been feeling these past two months, would you say you feel more persistently sad or hopeless, or more nervous, tense, and on edge?

More nervous and tense, I think, but also kind of down about it. Since I started trying to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I’ve been dropping little things I normally care about—like planning notes or design drafts—and then I feel guilty and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Over the past two months, has feeling sad, down, or hopeless been present most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just occasional low moments?
I don’t think it’s been there most of the day, every day. I have some low moments, but I wouldn’t call it constant hopelessness.
Over the past two months, have you often felt physically restless or keyed up, or noticed muscle tension, even when you're not actively thinking about the routine changes?
I haven’t really noticed physical restlessness or muscle tension like that, no.
Aside from the guilt and low moments, do you notice feeling nervous or on edge on most days, even when you're not actively thinking about the routine or image issues?
Not really most days when I’m not thinking about it. It’s more tied to the routine and image stuff—then I get tense, feel down, and guilty when I let the little planning or design things slide.
